hooks.command: if out=$(go build ./... 2>&1 && go test ./... 2>&1); then GOBIN="$HOME/.local/bin" go install . >/dev/null 2>&1 && jq -n '{systemMessage:"devdash: tests passed, deployed to ~/.local/bin"}' || jq -n '{systemMessage:"devdash: tests passed but go install failed"}'; else jq -n --arg o "$out" '{systemMessage:("devdash: NOT deployed - build or tests failed:\n"+$o)}'; fi
